The 4 KB LUT6 Page & 16 KB Nucleus [T/E/M · measured_j]

Scope note: 2^6=64 (LUT6 bits) and 4^3=64 (RNA triplets) is strictly a counting parallel for naming — NOT a biological isomorphism. Separates Thor INA3221 measured_j (162.56 nJ/op), MCU cycles & XC7A200T est_j.

1/2 Fourier proof & silicon runs:
- NucleusCodon.lean [T]: aligned 2-bit block invariance zeroes degree-5/6 Walsh-Hadamard terms (Linial et al. 1993)
- Jetson Thor INA3221 measured_j: 162.56 nJ/op bit-sliced (87x vs INT8 MLP) & 1,935 nJ scalar
- Alif M55: 684.6 DWT cycles scalar

2/2 M.2 XC7A200T gateware & thermal bound (est_j):
- Yosys + openXC7 closes 320.62 MHz post-PAR timing with (72,64) SECDED
- Unprobed DS181 model: 0.86 est_W / 55.2 est_C with DDR3 off, but flags 95.8 est_C (>85 C limit) thermal failure if DDR3+PCIe run in a 0 LFM slot
